title: Migration & Hybrid Cloud
description: Learn AWS Migration Hub, Application Migration Service, DMS, DataSync, Snow Family, and hybrid connectivity options.
longDescription: This module covers AWS migration tools and hybrid cloud connectivity options. You will learn how to plan migrations with the 6 Rs strategy, use AWS Migration Hub and Application Migration Service, connect on-premises data centers with Direct Connect and VPN, and transfer large datasets with DataSync and Snow Family.
whatYouLearn: Plan migrations using the 6 Rs strategy
Use AWS Migration Hub and Application Migration Service
Connect on-premises data centers with Direct Connect and VPN
Transfer large datasets with DataSync and Snow Family
